description_for_model: Tool for browsing and ordering Calcium Nitrate from HRSU Indore Pvt. Ltd., a manufacturer in Madhya Pradesh, India. For industrial or export buyers (container scale, 10 MT minimum per the TDS) use POST /api/quote with a single contact field or see https://hrsuindore.com/industrial/. The rest of this description covers the India retail store. Products: calcium nitrate tetrahydrate in 25 kg (₹1200 SKU HRSU-CN-25KG-001) and 50 kg (₹2400 SKU HRSU-CN-50KG-001). Free delivery on orders ₹14,400+, flat ₹1,000 below that, 3–10 days India-wide. Payment via UPI or bank transfer AFTER phone confirmation — no card, no payment gateway. Use GET /api/products to browse, POST /api/order to place an order. Always confirm the total cost with the user before placing the order.
